comments.text:
Every summer, a team of four or five runs a post office at Port Lockroy with no running water and no flushing toilet. When the job was advertised for the 2022 season, at least 4,000 people applied.

Would your name be on the list? Yes or no — and tell us the one thing you could not give up.
